visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long blonde hair and bangs, wearing a fuzzy blue and white striped sweater, stands in a bright indoor room with clean white walls. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures, appearing friendly and engaging. (2) She holds a blue branded box and a grey tube labeled 'Moody' toward the lens. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the physical product packaging. She points to her eyes, indicating the start of a beauty-related demonstration. (3) The woman puts on a Snoopy-themed headband to keep hair away from her face. She uses a wand applicator from the tube to carefully brush her eyelashes. Close-up shots emphasize the application process on both eyes. (4) Holding a large white makeup remover wipe, she gently presses it against her closed eye. When she pulls it away, dark makeup residue is visible on the cloth. Her skin appears clean and moist where she wiped. (5) She continues to wipe her entire face with the oversized sheet, demonstrating its large coverage area. She shows her face from multiple angles, highlighting a clear, hydrated complexion without any remaining makeup. (6) The video concludes with her smiling and posing with the products again. Text overlays and small variety-style graphic icons appear on screen to reinforce her positive review and the brand identity.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-fidelity female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a cheerful and professional tone. A medium-tempo acoustic pop BGM with a clear drum beat and melodic guitar starts simultaneously, providing a bright and energetic atmosphere. (2) Sound of plastic rustling occurs as she handles product packaging. A 'sparkle' sound effect is used to emphasize the appearance of the product brand visually. The speaker's volume remains consistent, maintaining a moderate conversational loudness level. (3) A soft mechanical click and slight friction sounds are heard as she presumably opens and uses a cosmetic wand. The BGM remains in the background at a lower volume, ensuring the narration is the primary focus. (4) A 'ding' sound effect marks a transition to the physical removal phase. The speaker's pitch remains varied, using rising intonations to convey excitement and enthusiasm about the cleaning results. (5) The acoustic guitar and piano in the BGM continue with a steady, uplifting rhythm. Minimal background noise is present, suggesting a controlled studio or indoor recording environment with a high signal-to-noise ratio. (6) A final 'pop' SFX accompanies the concluding recommendation. The music swells slightly in volume during the last few seconds before a clean fade-out, coinciding with the end of the speaker's closing remarks.
